newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 5.04 mln lbs canned meats for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 5.04 mln lbs canned meats for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 5,041,872 lbs of canned meat products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Canned Meat Product Pounds Awarded Prices/lb
Winning bidders for the canned beef were Dean Foods Vegetable Co (Milwaukee WI) 504,252 lb and Lakeside Foods Inc (Plainview MN) 3,241,620 lbs.
Winning bidder for the meatball stew was American Fine Foods (Payette ID) 1,296,000 lbs.
Total purchases since the program was announced Sept 26:
The latest award under Announcement LS-46, Invitation 8 and 9, will be shipped between December 12 and January 11, 1997.
